premises.text: CheckPoints is a store-agnostic mobile shopping rewards app: consumers earn and redeem rewards across over one million U.S. stores via iPhone
premises.evidence_span: Checkpoints is the first shopping rewards application that is store agnostic

premises.text: Advertisers reach targeted demographics in any store where their product is sold, delivering a message while the shopper has the product in hand (virtual end cap)
premises.evidence_span: They can reach consumers of the demographic they're looking for in any store in America where their product is sold

premises.text: In-store flow: nearby locations, featured aisle products, UPC scan to earn points, then an HTML5 product interaction page (coupon, Facebook like, app, recipe, survey)
premises.evidence_span: they just tap on the particular product that they're looking for, pick up their phone, put it over the UPC code

premises.text: Consumers earn coins from featured scans, play them for extra points, and redeem points for 40+ partner rewards delivered on phone
premises.evidence_span: Every time a user scans a featured product, they earn a coin

value.text: Advertisers drive in-store discovery and interaction while consumers earn fun extra rewards
value.evidence_span: allows advertisers to drive discovery and interaction in-store while providing a fun and rewarding opportunity for consumers

causal_links.evidence_span: consumers can earn rewards in over one million stores throughout the U.S. with just their iPhone
this advertising is reaching the consumer at that most valuable moment where they're in the store with the product in hand

notes: Scan→interaction-page media types folded as cascade of one in-aisle engagement mechanism (§4.1.7). Coin gaming and rewards catalog folded into consumer rewards module. Founder bio and named launch partners treated as credentials/traction (§4.2), not premises. Two domains: consumer rewards vs advertiser in-aisle reach as separately revisable.
